text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hafuu~! And that's it for the pigeon pose☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right! Just like this article says, 
I'll get a "heartwarming body that sweeps 
that special someone off their feet"—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what is this article!? "Body 
Sculpting Calisthenics to Drive Older Men 
Crazy"!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This one is "Yoga for Head-Turning 
Beautiful Legs"... Huh, this article over 
here is also...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!! If I do allll of this, Trainer-chan 
will fall head over heels for me!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm baaaack! Listen to this, Mayano~! The 
President just...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Mayanooo?! Why are you collapsed on 
the floor covered in sweat?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in her quest to make her Trainer 
swoon, Mayano Top Gun ended up completely 
pooped herself...
